user.title: Rival Aqua controller
user.description: Enter the IP address of the Rival WiFi controller on your network. Give it a DHCP reservation so the address doesn't change.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller. Check the IP address and that Home Assistant can reach that network.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the daily light schedule stored on the controller.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The Rival Aqua controller. Can be left empty when only one is set up.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Writes and saves the daily light schedule on the controller (same as Save in its web page), then resumes it.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The Rival Aqua controller. Can be left empty when only one is set up.

points.name: Points
points.description: Schedule points: time (HH:MM), levels (0-100 %, a list in channel order or a mapping of channel name to level) and optional fan. Up to 16 points; the light ramps linearly between them.

set_hotspot.name: Set hotspot
set_hotspot.description: Changes the controller's own Wi-Fi hotspot name and/or password (Advanced settings → Save on its web page). Channel names are re-sent unchanged.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The Rival Aqua controller. Can be left empty when only one is set up.

name.name: Name
name.description: 4-20 letters, digits, '-' or '_'. Leave empty to keep the current one.

password.name: Password
password.description: 8-12 digits. Leave empty to keep the current one.

scan_wifi.name: Scan Wi-Fi networks
scan_wifi.description: Lists the Wi-Fi networks the controller can see.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The Rival Aqua controller. Can be left empty when only one is set up.

connect_wifi.name: Join Wi-Fi network
connect_wifi.description: Makes the controller join another home network. It leaves the current one, so Home Assistant loses it until you set up the integration with its new IP address.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The Rival Aqua controller. Can be left empty when only one is set up.

ssid.name: Network
ssid.description: Network name (SSID), e.g. from Scan Wi-Fi networks.

forget_wifi.name: Forget Wi-Fi network
forget_wifi.description: Forgets the home network and reboots the controller into hotspot-only mode. Home Assistant can't reach it afterwards; reconnect it through its hotspot web page.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The Rival Aqua controller. Can be left empty when only one is set up.

factory_reset.name: Factory reset
factory_reset.description: Resets the controller's settings to defaults (Reset on its web page). Back up the schedule first.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The Rival Aqua controller. Can be left empty when only one is set up.
